open_points.subject: Identifier comparison across named models (Slot, Flow, ports, nodes, services, operations, agent names)
open_points.text: "slot_id: a stable name ... unique in the kernel"; "flow_id: a stable name the creating agent chooses"; "name: unique within its owner"
open_points.question: What exact equality rule is used for these names (case sensitivity and Unicode normalization), i.e., when are two names considered the same?
open_points.default_guess: Byte-exact, case-sensitive comparison with no normalization

open_points.subject: Agent read scope for implementation bodies (K-12 / inspect)
open_points.text: "For repair an agent receives one contract, its current implementation and that slot's recent traces and trial evidence; for composition, contracts, bindings and not implementation bodies."
open_points.question: Which product action and parameters determine that an agent is in "repair" scope, and exactly which implementation bodies become readable (only current of one slot, or more)?
options: Separate repair-read path requiring a slot id; only that slot's current implementation body is readable
Inspect action can return implementation bodies when caller asks for repair context
Agents may read implementation metadata broadly but code only for one slot's current activation
open_points.default_guess: Require explicit slot id and return only that slot's current implementation body

open_points.subject: Meaning of "recent" in repair evidence
open_points.text: "that slot's recent traces and trial evidence"
open_points.question: What defines "recent" for traces and trial evidence returned to the agent (time window, count limit, or all records)?
options: Records within a fixed time window

open_points.subject: ManifestOperation instance facts when no instance is selected
open_points.text: "base_url: the manifest's base URL of the one instance the installation selects for the service" and "each is absent when the installation selects no instance" (stated for required_headers and instance_class), plus "its ManifestOperation then read without instance facts"
open_points.question: When no instance is selected, is `base_url` also absent, and is a ManifestOperation still materialized for proposal/invocation checks?
options: ManifestOperation is materialized, with all instance-derived fields (including base_url) absent
ManifestOperation is not materialized at all when no instance is selected
ManifestOperation is materialized with some fallback base_url
open_points.default_guess: Materialize it, with all instance-derived fields absent (including base_url)

open_points.subject: Agent-visible approval preview vs personal-data rule
open_points.text: "preview: what the owner saw — operation, target service, the built request and the input values; agents may read approvals, and an agent receives personal-data values only as digest and class"
open_points.question: If the built HTTP request (URL/headers/body) contains personal data, what exactly is returned to an agent reading the approval preview?
options: Return full built request only to owner; agent gets redacted/digested personal-data parts
Return built request to agent unchanged, relying only on value redaction
Do not expose approval preview to agents
open_points.default_guess: Owner sees full preview; agent sees preview with personal-data-derived parts replaced by digest/class
